'''Jessa Bo'den''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] green-skinned [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was a high-ranking member of the [[Justicars' Brigade]], a vigilante militia that controlled a [[Justicar territory|portion]] of Coruscant. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a Republic-allied individual in order to secure the access codes she had acquired that would have allowed the Justicars to enter secure Republic facilities.

==Behind the scenes==
Jessa Bo'den was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. Jessa appears in the Justicars' Tower, as the final boss of the bonus mission in Justicar Territory.
